A subscription buys your brand a set number of RepShare hours each week, billed monthly from your wallet. Move up, down or top up as you grow.

PlanHours a weekPer monthHourly rate
Kickstart5$2,695$95–$115

Monthly prices include GST, as published on our Brands page. Cars, phones, tolls and parking are included.

Your break-even sum

Break-even is the number of cases a month whose gross profit covers your monthly RepShare cost: your plan, plus any usage above its allowance.

Monthly cost ex GST ÷ your gross profit per case = cases a month to break even

For example, Kickstart is $2,450 a month ex GST. With no usage above the allowance and $60 gross profit a case, that is about 41 cases a month across all the venues your reps open and re-order. Put your own margin in: the sum is the same.

Two things shorten it: the $500 credit off your first month, and reorders. When a venue orders your brand again, a repeat-order credit comes back off your usage.

Straight answer

What if it doesn’t work?

Every plan has a 30-day pro-rata money-back guarantee on your first month, and no lock-ins. Targets and KPIs are goals, not guarantees: nobody can promise sales, but you can see every hour and every visit.
